welcome.title: Welcome to Family Tree
welcome.body: This quick tour walks you through the main features. You can relaunch it any time from the user menu.

create-tree.title: Create your first tree
create-tree.body: Click Next to open the dialog where your first family tree gets created.

existing-tree.title: Continue with this tree
existing-tree.body: You already have a tree selected, so we will skip setup and jump straight into the everyday tools.

add-member.title: Add your first person
add-member.body: Click here to add a person to the tree. Once added, you can edit their details and link them to parents, children, and partners.

sidebar-panel.title: Your sidebar
sidebar-panel.body: Here you can switch between your family trees, customise the appearance (theme, language, edge style), and access your account settings via the user menu at the bottom.

switch-views.title: Navigate between views
switch-views.body: These tabs switch you between different views of your data — tree, list, timeline, map, statistics, and more. Let's head to Tree Management next.

tree-management.title: Tree Management
tree-management.body: From here you can create new trees, share an existing tree with friends as a viewer or editor, and import or export your data.

friends.title: Friends & sharing
friends.body: Search for other users by username, send a friend request, and once accepted you can invite them to any of your trees.

finish.title: You're all set!
finish.body: That's the tour. You can relaunch it any time from the user menu in the sidebar. Enjoy building your family tree!

tree-name.title: Name your tree
tree-name.body: We've started you off with a name — you can rename your tree any time later. Click Next to create it.
